name: Texas
notes: Texas does not give a state-run notary exam. This mock exam is a self-check built on the same law new notaries must know.
disclaimer: Study aid only, not legal advice. Questions are based on Texas Government Code ch. 406, Civil Practice & Remedies Code ch. 121, 1 Texas Administrative Code ch. 87 and Texas Secretary of State notary guidance. Check the Secretary of State's current notary publications before relying on any rule.
